Name: Ahimelech, Son of Ahitub
Summary: Ahimelech, son of Ahitub, was priest at Nob. He gave David the showbread and Goliath's sword, believing David on the king's business, and Saul had him and eighty-five priests murdered for it on Doeg's report.
KeyStory: Ahimelech fed a fugitive in good faith and was murdered for it, with his whole priestly city.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; King David; Doeg the Edomite; Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech
LifeLesson: Kindness to a fugitive can cost everything — and still be right.
